meta.source: hand-owned; every other file is built from this one by dev/visual-preference/build.py

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page ground. Stone grey with the faintest green; matte.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels and quiet blocks on the ground.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Panels that float, for example over a map.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between sections. Decoration only, never a control edge.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: Borders of controls (fields, switches); 3:1 on the ground.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, captions, axis text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text and the strongest marks.

tokens.name: lichen
tokens.usage: Home accent: Yili's own site, CV, papers and mark, and the default for a new project. Marks the one focus or action.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Project accent. One accent per project; marks the one focus or action.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Project accent. One accent per project; marks the one focus or action.

tokens.name: data-sky
tokens.usage: Groups in data, Earth 6 slot 1.

tokens.name: data-rust
tokens.usage: Groups in data, Earth 6 slot 2; Earth 8 slot 2.

tokens.name: data-spruce
tokens.usage: Groups in data, Earth 6 slot 3; Earth 8 slot 3.

tokens.name: data-sand
tokens.usage: Groups in data, Earth 6 slot 4; Earth 8 slot 4.

tokens.name: data-dusk
tokens.usage: Groups in data, Earth 6 slot 5; Earth 8 slot 5.

tokens.name: data-ochre
tokens.usage: Groups in data, Earth 6 slot 6. Not in Earth 8.

tokens.name: data-glacier
tokens.usage: Groups in data, Earth 8 slot 1. Only for 7-8 groups.

tokens.name: data-rose
tokens.usage: Groups in data, Earth 8 slot 6. Only for 7-8 groups.

tokens.name: data-olive
tokens.usage: Groups in data, Earth 8 slot 7. Only for 7-8 groups. Earth 8 slot 8 is data-sky.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Spaced capital labels over groups and sections.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page at most: a name or a title.

styles.name: num
styles.usage: Numbers in tables, readouts and stats. Albert Sans has no tabular figures.

styles.name: doc-h1
styles.usage: Headings in long documents only: papers, CV, essays.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Label to its control.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside a dense panel.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Inside a panel; from a window edge.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections on a small screen.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Around a page header.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between major parts of a long page.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Every corner: square everywhere.

tokens.name: radius-dot
tokens.usage: Dots only, such as a status dot.

tokens.name: float
tokens.usage: The one shadow: panels floating over a map or an image, so they stay legible. Nothing else casts a shadow.

tokens.name: fast
tokens.usage: Hover and small state changes.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Panels and sheets opening. Off for reduced motion.

tokens.name: out
tokens.usage: Every movement eases out; nothing bounces.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: The widest a column of text may be.

tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: The widest a page's content may be.

tokens.name: focus-width
tokens.usage: Focus ring width, in the accent.

tokens.name: focus-offset
tokens.usage: Gap between a control and its focus ring.
